title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for Blazor page/WASM debug session to become interactive
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision <timestamp>: Error: Timed out after ~291000ms waiting for pwa-msedge child session for Blazor WASM root '<guid>'. Last error: <none>.
analysis: Timeout waiting for the pwa-msedge child debug session to attach to a Blazor WASM root in a Windows E2E environment. This is a timing-sensitive external browser/debugger interaction unrelated to the PR's Python uv.lock dependency bump in unrelated playground projects. Matches a recurring pattern of Blazor browser debugger E2E timeouts in this job.
